question: In May 2023, who was sworn in as the new Central Vigilance Commissioner of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**PK Srivastava**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PK Srivastava** was sworn in as the **new Central Vigilance Commissioner (CVC)** of India in May 2023.
 
• The **Central Vigilance Commission** is an apex Indian governmental body created in 1964 to address governmental corruption.
 
• The CVC operates as an independent authority and is responsible for monitoring and advising on all vigilance activities under the central government of India.
 
• **PK Srivastava** succeeded **Suresh N Patel**, who served as the previous Central Vigilance Commissioner.
 
• He brings extensive experience in the field of **administration and vigilance**, which is critical for curbing corruption and ensuring transparency in governance.
 
• The appointment of the CVC is made by the President of India based on the recommendation of a committee comprising the **Prime Minister, the Home Minister, and the Leader of the Opposition**.
 
• The tenure of the Central Vigilance Commissioner is **four years** or until the age of 65, whichever is earlier.
 
• The CVC plays a pivotal role in ensuring the implementation of the **Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988** and other relevant anti-corruption laws in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **GC Murmu**__

 __
 
• **GC Murmu** has served as the **Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India**. He was appointed as the 14th CAG of India in August 2020.
 
• The CAG is responsible for auditing the accounts of the central and state governments and ensuring accountability in the use of public funds.
 
 
 
• **Amit Khare**__
 __
 
• **Amit Khare** is a retired Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer known for his role in exposing the **fodder scam** in Bihar during his tenure as a district magistrate.
 
• He served as the **Information and Broadcasting Secretary** and later as the **Education Secretary** of India.
 
 
 
• **Suresh N Patel**__
 
 
• **Suresh N Patel** was the **previous Central Vigilance Commissioner** of India, serving until May 2023.
 
• He was known for his efforts to strengthen vigilance mechanisms and promote ethical governance during his tenure.
